Create ONE finished visual novel CG, opaque landscape 16:9, 1920x1080 target. A hopeful, epic, happy emotional culmination: six old friends finally reunited aboard the TAIKUN, ready to rescue Ilona and recover their lost home after a millennium. Express warm joy, solidarity, courage and the relief of having made it together. A heroic promise of homecoming, before any combat occurs.

Input images are REFERENCES, not edit targets, in this exact order:
1: passerelle_taikun.png — strict environment continuity, sweeping panoramic windows, curved bronze ribs, warm amber lights, sober teal consoles, immense face-bearing planet outside.
2: Theo/laplage_neutral.png — Theo's exact likeness and beige coat, dark turtleneck, glasses, grey swept hair, small grey moustache and external green creeper keychain.
3: Jessy/prophet_with_gem.png — Jessy's exact likeness: BROWN hair and very long BROWN beard, black rectangular glasses, white prophet robe and large red gemstone pendant; he has not aged, do not give him white hair.
4: Allan/military_commander.png — Allan's exact likeness: short greying hair and stubble, grey command uniform with pale tie, peaked officer cap, grey cape and aviator glasses.
5: Micka/armor_commanding.png — Micka's exact likeness: grey swept-back hair and short beard, NO glasses, dark grey segmented futuristic armor with red and white shoulder stripes.
6: Sofiane/armor_focused.png — Sofiane's exact likeness: dark ponytail streaked grey, short grey beard, black rectangular glasses, slate blue padded tactical spacesuit, tan utility pouches, small orange and white details.

Scene and composition: INSIDE the established TAIKUN bridge, all SIX men physically together in ONE natural, coherent wide three-quarter group composition, waist to thigh framing, all faces large enough to recognize. Camera from slightly to the side of the panoramic window so we see their faces and the view beyond. This must be a fully painted narrative scene with interaction, not a row of cutout sprites, no collage. Theo slightly forward near center-right delivers his final rallying words with a confident warm smile and an open welcoming hand aimed toward the horizon. Jessy beside him on center-left has a young face framed by his long brown beard, a joyful emotional smile and moist eyes, one hand at his red pendant; Theo's other hand rests naturally on Jessy's shoulder, solidarity. Allan at far left shares a relieved grin with Micka beside him; Florentin near Theo looks proud and quietly hopeful, shoulders finally relaxed. Sofiane toward far right at a low pilot console, half turned toward friends with an unmistakable small smile, hands resting naturally on the controls. Keep exactly these six distinct men, with distinct hair, facial hair and clothing; no duplicates, no additional crew, no woman inside the bridge.
All six faces and key gestures in the upper two-thirds, dialogue area lower quarter quieter but still naturally painted.

Behind them the enormous Ilonanium is visible through the existing curved windows, with pink/cream/green/blue clouded terrain and two immense brown eyes integrated in the spherical planet's surface, recognizable as in the bridge reference. It remains an uncanny planet, not a giant woman. A pale warm rim along its atmospheric horizon and amber bridge lighting cast beautiful golden light on the friends, balanced with gentle teal console glow and deep blue stars. Their expressions and the luminous horizon communicate that hope has returned. No new sun disc or extra planet, no magically changed Earth, no orbital city outside.
Style: polished detailed hand-drawn anime visual novel CG, precise fine dark contours, painted environments, softly blended cel shading, richly textured fabric and metal, believable anatomy, cinematic depth, warm expressive faces, coherent with the references. Epic scale with intimate human happiness. Adult friends, mature dignified features.
Single full-frame illustration; no panels, captions, dialogue, UI, borders, watermark, prominent writing or added slogans. No battle underway, guns drawn, explosions, horror grimaces, ominous red lighting, caricature or gag. Do not paste sprites. Preserve all six identities and their outfits.
